goal: Lets wallet RPCs (sendtoaddress, send, sendall, sendmany) broadcast via short-lived Tor/I2P connections when -privatebroadcast=1 is set, instead of the normal mempool relay.
Aims to give wallet users the same origin-privacy benefit that raw-transaction broadcast already gets from PR #29415.
reviewability: Paused: author said they will rebase on top of #34533 once it merges because the two PRs overlap in MaybeResendWalletTxs.
Also stale: needs rebase, marked draft, and no author activity in over 200 days.
agreement: Concept ACKs from two reviewers with no objections to the core idea (andrewtoth, Bicaru20).
mzumsande raised real design gaps (RPC-submitted wallet txs still leak over clearnet after restart, feebump behavior) that were only partially addressed (mzumsande).
andrewtoth flagged direct functional overlap with PR #34533 that the author agreed needs a rebase (andrewtoth, w0xlt).
rkrux suggested splitting off two self-contained commits, unanswered so far (rkrux).

result.summary: Extends the private-broadcast feature (from #29415) to wallet transaction submission: CommitTransaction() and MaybeResendWalletTxs() use short-lived Tor/I2P connections when -privatebroadcast=1 is set, and the Tor/I2P availability check is centralized into BroadcastTransaction(). Includes a Qt fix for an uncaught exception in the send dialog and new functional tests plus SOCKS5 test helpers. The design went through several iterations, most recently dropping a per-transaction mapValue flag in favor of making broadcast method purely a function of the current -privatebroadcast setting.
result.problem: Wallet users who enable -privatebroadcast currently get no privacy benefit for wallet-originated sends: those still broadcast over ordinary mempool relay to all peers, unlike raw transactions submitted via sendrawtransaction after #29415. This PR closes that gap for privacy-conscious wallet users.

open_concerns: mzumsande: RPC-submitted (not wallet-CommitTransaction-originated) wallet transactions still get rebroadcast over clearnet after a restart without -privatebroadcast, and feebumping after such a restart would also go over clearnet; only partially addressed.
andrewtoth: MaybeResendWalletTxs change overlaps with #34533's version of the same method; author agreed to rebase once #34533 merges but has not done so.
rkrux: two commits (Qt exception fix, Socks5ProxyHelper test infra) look separable into their own PRs; not yet acted on.
resolved_concerns: andrewtoth's rebroadcast-direction concern (skip only private→public, not public→private) was implemented by the author.
Bicaru20's flaky-test timing issue in wallet_private_broadcast.py was investigated and a fix path identified (same root cause as #34387/#34410).

categories.name: wallet
categories.evidence: Directly changes CommitTransaction() and MaybeResendWalletTxs() in src/wallet/wallet.cpp, adds wallet functional tests, and is labeled Wallet.
categories.rationale: P2 because it closes a real privacy gap for wallet users who enable -privatebroadcast, extending a feature the project already shipped for raw transactions (#29415) to the much more commonly used wallet send path. The wallet category explicitly ranks 'privacy of transaction creation' highly; however mzumsande's unresolved point that RPC-submitted wallet transactions can still leak over clearnet on restart shows the design is not yet complete, and functional overlap with the sibling PR #34533 means this needs to be reconciled before it is mergeable, which caps it below P1.

categories.name: p2p
categories.evidence: Labeled Private Broadcast and centralizes the Tor/I2P reachability check inside BroadcastTransaction(), but the substantive change is wallet-side wiring rather than new p2p transport or connection-management logic.
categories.rationale: P4 because the p2p mechanism itself (short-lived Tor/I2P private-broadcast connections) already exists from #29415; this PR only relocates an availability check and makes existing wallet callers use that existing mechanism, with no new protocol behavior, DoS, or relay-correctness impact for the p2p category to weigh.

result.card: This PR extends the private-broadcast privacy feature (from merged #29415) to wallet transaction submission, so sendtoaddress/send/sendall/sendmany broadcast over short-lived Tor/I2P connections when -privatebroadcast=1, and it centralizes the Tor/I2P availability check into BroadcastTransaction(). The problem it addresses is real: wallet-originated sends currently get no privacy benefit from -privatebroadcast even though raw-transaction submission already does, which matters to privacy-conscious wallet users. Concept ACKs came from andrewtoth and Bicaru20, but reviewer mzumsande identified an unresolved gap where wallet-relevant transactions submitted via RPC can still leak over clearnet after a restart, and the author's own MaybeResendWalletTxs changes substantively overlap with the open sibling PR #34533. The author explicitly said he would rebase on top of #34533 once it merges and has since gone silent for over 200 days, leaving the PR in draft, needing rebase, and effectively paused pending that dependency.
